jobs.description:
Bei Endress+Hauser geschieht Fortschritt durch Zusammenarbeit. Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Messgeräten gestalten unsere rund 17.000 Mitarbeitenden die Zukunft im Bereich der Prozessautomatisierung. Ob bei der Innovation und Umsetzung neuer Technologien im Team, der Zusammenarbeit in der Entwicklung neuer Geräte oder der Stärkung wichtiger Beziehungen zu verschiedenen globalen Industrien: Unsere Arbeit basiert darauf, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufzubauen, die allen zum Erfolg verhelfen. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen schauen wir über kurzfristige Ziele hinaus und arbeiten daran, eine zukunftsorientierte Vision für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und die Welt im Allgemeinen zu schaffen.

Für unseren Standort suchen wir eine*n Spezialist*in für Elektrotechnik & Gebäudeautomation (m/w/d), um unsere technischen Anlagen weiterzuentwickeln und die Gebäudeautomation zukunftsorientiert zu gestalten.

Worum geht es in dieser Stelle?

Gestalten Sie aktiv die Zukunft intelligenter Gebäude. Bei Endress+Hauser übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Weiterentwicklung unserer modernen Gebäude- und Energieinfrastruktur. Sie stellen sicher, dass unsere technischen Anlagen zuverlässig, sicher und energieeffizient betrieben werden und bringen gleichzeitig innovative Projekte in den Bereichen Gebäudeautomation und Digitalisierung voran.

In einem internationalen Industrieumfeld erwartet Sie ein vielseitiges und anspruchsvolles Aufgabengebiet. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, die einen direkten Einfluss auf Energieeffizienz, Betriebssicherheit und die langfristige Leistungsfähigkeit unserer Infrastruktur haben.

Wenn Sie sich für Elektrotechnik, Gebäudeautomation und digitale Technologien begeistern und Verantwortung in einem zukunftsorientierten Umfeld übernehmen möchten, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.

Welche Aufgaben werden Sie übernehmen?

Sie werden:

• die elektrotechnischen Anlagen sowie die Gebäudeautomation planen, betreiben und kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln – mit dem Ziel eines sicheren, stabilen und energieeffizienten Anlagenbetriebs

• die Verantwortung für sicherheitsrelevante Systeme wie Brandmeldeanlagen, Einbruchmeldeanlagen, Notbeleuchtungen sowie Netzersatzanlagen übernehmen und deren einwandfreie Funktion gewährleisten

• Projekte im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Gebäudeautomation und Energieoptimierung eigenständig umsetzen und technisch begleiten – von der Konzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme

• als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Elektrotechnik, IT/OT und externen Dienstleistern fungieren und eine reibungslose Integration der Systeme sicherstellen

At Endress+Hauser, progress is made through collaboration. As a family-run company, we look beyond short-term goals and work to create a future-oriented vision for our employees, our customers and the world in general. We are looking for a committed personality for an internship as an Industrial Software Engineer (m/f/d) to complement our global team and actively shape digitalization in the industrial environment. In this role, you will contribute to further developing software solutions that create real added value in production and engineering and make processes simpler, more efficient and more sustainable. What is the point about? Do you want to develop software that makes a real difference in an industrial environment? Does it appeal to you to translate technical requirements together with different specialist areas into practical solutions? And do you want to work on applications that make data usable and advance digitalization in production? Then you can expect an exciting internship in which you can contribute your knowledge, learn new things and work on tasks that have an indirect effect in the everyday life of many people. What tasks will you take on? You will:
• participate in the design and development of software solutions in the industrial environment.
• Analyse and further develop existing tools and applications.
• Design new solutions for processing product, configuration or manufacturing data.
• Implement software components, such as backend services or web applications.
• Clarify and implement requirements together with internal stakeholders, for example from engineering or production.
• contribute to the automation and digitalization of processes in production. What do we expect from you? You:
• studies computer science or a comparable degree program, ideally related to software engineering, web technologies or similar topics.
• have gained initial practical experience in software development, for example in projects, studies or internships.
• bring your first knowledge of common programming languages or frameworks and are interested in modern web technologies in the frontend or backend.
• are interested in technical systems and industrial applications, knowledge of API or data processing is advantageous.
• communicate safely in German or English in word and writing.
• work carefully and independently, take responsibility, be open to new things and learn quickly. What can you expect from us?
• We are a family-run, committed company with a sustainable vision.
• We promote lifelong learning with versatile training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e-learning.
• We support work-life balance with flexible working hours.
• We offer support in sustainable mobility solutions such as public transport. How do you apply? To apply, please upload your documents to our career page. Applications sent to us by e-mail can unfortunately not be considered for data protection reasons. Agencies, personnel service providers or similar companies are asked to refrain from the unsolicited transmission of profiles and requests for possible cooperation. We do not currently work with external service providers for this position. All unsolicited applications from service providers are not considered and deleted without further examination. Thank you for your understanding. Apply now.

• responsible for project procurement for strategic investments in new construction, conversion and renovation projects.
• manage the entire procurement process – from demand notification to auditing, including negotiations and contract drafting.
• act as the central point of contact for procurement issues at our global production sites.
• develop, manage and evaluate the supplier portfolio based on performance, quality and reliability.
• work closely with internal and external stakeholders and actively support site planning. What do we expect from you? They:
• have a bachelor’s degree in business administration, construction, facility management or a comparable qualification with further training in purchasing.
• bring at least 5 years of experience in purchasing, ideally in the field of construction services and project management in an international environment.
• have in-depth knowledge of RFI/RFP processes and in the investment environment (CapEx); SIA knowledge is an advantage.
• work analytically, structured and coordinate several projects securely in parallel.
• communicate convincingly and confidently in German and English; Knowledge of French is an advantage.
• act independently, proactively and keep an overview even under time pressure. What can you expect from us?
• We are a family company with great commitment and a sustainable vision.
• We offer you an exciting environment with an international orientation and great scope for design.
• We promote lifelong learning through training, knowledge transfer and e‐learning.
• We support flexible working models and a balanced work-life balance.
• We offer modern working conditions and attractive employment conditions. How do you apply? To apply, we ask you to upload your documents to our career page. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen schauen wir über kurzfristige Ziele hinaus und arbeiten daran, eine zukunftsorientierte Vision für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und die Welt im Allgemeinen zu schaffen.

Wir suchen eine*n Strategische*n Einkäufer*in Bau / Baudienstleistungen, um unsere globalen Beschaffungsaktivitäten weiterzuentwickeln und anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte strategisch zu steuern.

Worum geht es in dieser Stelle?

Möchten Sie komplexe Beschaffungsprojekte im Bauumfeld steuern? Haben Sie Freude daran, Lieferantenstrategien aktiv weiterzuentwickeln? Reizt es Sie, mit Ihren Analysen und Verhandlungen direkten Einfluss auf die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu nehmen?

Dann erwartet Sie eine vielseitige Rolle mit grossem Gestaltungsspielraum, in der Sie globale Beschaffungsstrategien aktiv mitprägen.

Welche Aufgaben werden Sie übernehmen?

Sie werden:

• Beschaffungsstrategien für Baudienstleistungen entwickeln und umsetzen, mit Fokus auf Kostenoptimierung und Risikomanagement.

• die Projektbeschaffung für strategische Investitionen in Neubau‑, Umbau‑ und Sanierungsprojekte verantworten.

• den gesamten Beschaffungsprozess steuern – von der Bedarfsmeldung bis zur Rechnungsprüfung inklusive Verhandlungen und Vertragsgestaltung.

• als zentrale Ansprechperson für Beschaffungsfragen an unseren globalen Produktionsstandorten agieren.

• das Lieferantenportfolio entwickeln, managen und anhand von Leistung, Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit bewerten.

• eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten und die Standortplanung aktiv unterstützen.

Was erwarten wir von Ihnen?

Sie:

• verfügen über einen Bachelorabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Bau, Facility Management oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Weiterbildung im Einkauf.

• bringen mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Einkauf mit, idealerweise im Bereich Baudienstleistungen und Projektmanagement im internationalen Umfeld.

• besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in RFI/RFP‑Prozessen sowie im Investitionsumfeld (CapEx); SIA‑Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• arbeiten analytisch, strukturiert und koordinieren mehrere Projekte parallel sicher.

• kommunizieren überzeugend und verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch; Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• handeln selbständig, proaktiv und behalten auch unter Zeitdruck den Überblick.

• Wir sind ein Familienunternehmen mit grossem Engagement und einer nachhaltigen Vision.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Endress+ Hauser, i progressi sono fatti attraverso la collaborazione. Che si tratti di innovare e implementare nuove tecnologie in un team, lavorare insieme per sviluppare nuovi dispositivi, o rafforzare relazioni importanti con diverse industrie globali, il nostro lavoro si basa sulla costruzione di relazioni di fiducia che aiutano tutti ad avere successo. Come azienda a conduzione familiare, guardiamo oltre gli obiettivi a breve termine e lavoriamo per creare una visione orientata al futuro per i nostri dipendenti, i nostri clienti e il mondo in generale. Qual è il ruolo? Stiamo cercando un manager a turni per la produzione di clienti che completa il nostro team globale con competenze e leadership. Essi si assumono la responsabilità nella produzione, modellano attivamente i processi e assicurano che i nostri elevati standard di qualità siano implementati quotidianamente. Quali compiti assumerai?
• Si guida un turno con 10-13 dipendenti nell'operazione a 2 turni e sviluppare ulteriormente il vostro team.
• Pianificano, coordinano e gestiscono il business giorno per raggiungere gli obiettivi impostati in modo efficiente.
• Essi implementano costantemente standard di qualità, linee guida di sicurezza e standard interni e promuovono la loro conformità.
• Iniziate i processi di miglioramento continuo (Kaizen) e metteteli insieme al vostro team.
• Lei è responsabile della Manutenzione Autonoma come parte della nostra strategia TPM e agisce come esempio direttamente sul piano del negozio. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te?
• Hanno una formazione tecnica di base e una formazione ulteriore come manager, maestro o tecnico.
• Porti diversi anni di esperienza professionale e manageriale nell'ambiente tecnico e utilizzi il tuo know-how in modo mirato.
• Sono comunicativi, organizzati ed entusiasti di promuovere e sviluppare le persone.
• Sei fiducioso nel trattare con MS Office e SAP e idealmente avere la prima esperienza con i metodi LEAN.
• Essi padroneggiano la lingua tedesca in modo sicuro nella parola e nella scrittura e portano idealmente ulteriori competenze linguistiche, lavorano in modo indipendente, flessibile e orientato al team. Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi?
• Siamo una società a conduzione familiare, impegnata con una visione sostenibile.
• Promuoviamo l'apprendimento per tutta la vita con una formazione versatile e ulteriori opportunità di istruzione, trasferimento di conoscenze interne e e-learning.
• Sosteniamo l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa con orari di lavoro flessibili.
• Offriamo supporto a soluzioni di mobilità sostenibile come i trasporti pubblici.
• Sosteniamo le politiche per famiglie, compresi i luoghi per l'infanzia e i servizi per l'infanzia durante le vacanze. Come si applica? Per richiedere, ti chiediamo di caricare i tuoi documenti nella nostra pagina di carriera. Le domande inviateci via e-mail non possono purtroppo essere considerate per motivi di protezione dei dati. Agenzie, fornitori di servizi del personale o società simili sono tenuti a astenersi dalla trasmissione non richiesta di profili e richieste di possibile cooperazione. Attualmente non lavoriamo con fornitori di servizi esterni per questa posizione. Tutte le applicazioni non richieste dai fornitori di servizi non vengono considerate e eliminate senza ulteriori esami. Grazie per la vostra comprensione. Applichi subito. Traduzione:

A Endress+ Hauser, i progressi sono fatti attraverso la collaborazione. Come fornitore leader mondiale di strumenti di misura, i nostri oltre 17.000 dipendenti stanno plasmando il futuro nel campo dell’automazione dei processi. Che si tratti di innovare e implementare nuove tecnologie in un team, lavorare insieme per sviluppare nuovi dispositivi o rafforzare relazioni importanti con diverse industrie globali, il nostro lavoro si basa sulla costruzione di relazioni di fiducia che aiutano tutti ad avere successo. Come azienda a conduzione familiare, guardiamo oltre gli obiettivi a breve termine e lavoriamo per creare una visione orientata al futuro per i nostri dipendenti, i nostri clienti e il mondo in generale. Cerchiamo una gestione degli ordini + SAP Master Data Expert – 80-100% (m/f/d) per rafforzare il nostro know-how nell'elaborazione degli ordini e nella gestione dei dati SAP master presso Endress+ Hauser Digital Solutions. Digital Solutions guida la trasformazione digitale in Endress+ Hauser e supporta i nostri clienti e colleghi in tutto il mondo con soluzioni intelligenti e connesse che rendono i processi più efficienti e sostenibili. Cosa c'è in gioco qui? Ti piace gestire gli ordini dei clienti in modo preciso ed efficiente mantenendo traccia dell'intero processo? Ti piace lavorare in tutti i dipartimenti con team di acquisto, produzione, logistica e vendita? Stai prosperando in un ruolo in cui non sei solo responsabile per i processi di master data, ma attivamente svilupparli e formare e sostenere gli altri? In questo ruolo, hai l'opportunità di plasmare attivamente l'elaborazione degli ordini e la gestione dei dati SAP master e creare un valore aggiunto sostenibile. Nell'ambito di Digital Solutions, svolgete un ruolo centrale nella gestione dell'intero processo di ordinazione – dall'ingresso alla consegna – e garantite una collaborazione regolare tra tutti i dipartimenti interni rilevanti. L'utente guida l'istituzione e l'ulteriore sviluppo dei processi di master data e rappresenta un importante referente per gli utenti chiave e finali nel trattare con SAP. Quali compiti assumerai? Essi:
• Registra e elabora gli ordini dei clienti nel sistema ERP (SAP)
• Controllare i dati dell'ordine compresi i prezzi, i tempi di consegna e la disponibilità del materiale
• Assicurare il coordinamento con i dipartimenti interni come l'acquisto, la produzione, la logistica e le vendite
• Monitorare l'intero processo di ordine dal ricevimento dell'ordine alla consegna
• Crea report e valutazioni sullo stato dell'ordine, sui tempi di consegna e sui colli di bottiglia
• Assunzione della responsabilità per SAP Master Data Management
• Stabilire, documentare e sviluppare continuamente processi di dati master
• Formare e supportare gli utenti chiave e finali nel trattare i processi di dati master Cosa ci aspettiamo da te? Loro:
• Avere completato l'istruzione commerciale o una qualifica simile
• Portare almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale nel trattamento degli ordini
• Avere esperienza nella cooperazione transfrontaliera con vari stakeholder
• Avere competenze ERP sonore in SAP (MM/SD/PP)
• Avere forti capacità organizzative per eseguire più attività in tempo ed efficiente
• Convincere attraverso elevata forza di comunicazione, competenza sociale, lavoro di squadra e assertività
• Portare capacità di problem solving per le modifiche della data di consegna, parti difettose e reclami
• Master tedesco e inglese negoziabile in parola e scrittura Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi?
• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e innovativo all'avanguardia della trasformazione digitale.
• Opportunità per lo sviluppo professionale e personale attraverso opportunità di formazione e apprendimento versatili.
• Una cultura del lavoro flessibile e familiare che supporta l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa.
• Un pacchetto di compensazione attraente con benefici aggiuntivi, compresi i programmi di salute e benessere.
• L'opportunità di far parte di un'azienda che vive sostenibilità, diversità e visione a lungo termine. Come si applica? descriptionByLocale.en:
At Endress+Hauser, progress is made through collaboration. As the world’s leading provider of measuring instruments, our more than 17,000 employees are shaping the future in the field of process automation. Whether it’s innovating and implementing new technologies in a team, working together to develop new devices or strengthening important relationships with different global industries, our work is based on building trusted relationships that help everyone succeed. As a family-run company, we look beyond short-term goals and work to create a future-oriented vision for our employees, our customers and the world in general.

We are looking for an order handling + SAP Master Data Expert – 80-100% (m/f/d) to strengthen our know-how in order processing and SAP master data management at Endress+Hauser Digital Solutions. Digital Solutions drives the digital transformation within Endress+Hauser and supports our customers and colleagues worldwide with intelligent, connected solutions that make processes more efficient and sustainable.

What is at stake here?

Do you enjoy handling customer orders precisely and efficiently while keeping track of the entire process? Do you enjoy working across departments with teams from purchasing, production, logistics and sales? Are you flourishing in a role where you are not only responsible for master data processes, but actively develop them and train and support others?

In this role, you have the opportunity to actively shape order processing and SAP master data management and create sustainable added value. As part of Digital Solutions, you play a central role in managing the entire ordering process – from entry to delivery – and ensure smooth cooperation between all relevant internal departments. You drive the establishment and further development of master data processes and are an important contact person for key and end users in dealing with SAP.

What tasks will you take on?

They shall:

• Record and process customer orders in the ERP system (SAP)

• Check order data including prices, delivery times and material availability

• Ensure coordination with internal departments such as purchasing, production, logistics and sales

• Monitor the entire order process from order receipt to delivery

• Create reporting and evaluations on order status, lead times and bottlenecks

• Taking responsibility for SAP Master Data Management

• Establish, document and continuously develop master data processes

• Train and support key and end users in dealing with master data processes

What do we expect from you?

They:

• Have completed commercial education or a comparable qualification

• Bring at least 5 years of professional experience in order processing

• Have experience in cross-departmental cooperation with various stakeholders

• Have sound ERP skills in SAP (MM/SD/PP)

• Have strong organizational skills to execute multiple tasks on time and efficiently

• Convincing through high communication strength, social competence, teamwork and assertiveness

• Bring problem-solving skills for delivery date changes, faulty parts and complaints

• Master German and English negotiable in word and writing

What can you expect from us?

• A dynamic and innovative working environment at the forefront of digital transformation.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development through versatile training and learning opportunities.

• A flexible and family-friendly work culture that supports work-life balance.

• An attractive compensation package with additional benefits, including health and wellness programs.

• The opportunity to be part of a company that lives sustainability, diversity and a long-term vision.

How do you apply?

To apply, we ask you to upload your documents to our career page. Applications sent to us by e-mail can unfortunately not be considered for data protection reasons.

Agencies, personnel service providers or similar companies are asked to refrain from unsolicited sending of profiles and requests regarding possible cooperation. We do not currently work with external service providers for this position. Unsolicited applications are ignored and deleted without further examination. Thank you for your understanding.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Endress+Hauser, progress is made through collaboration. As the world’s leading provider of measuring instruments, our approximately 17,000 employees are shaping the future in the field of process automation. Whether it’s innovating and implementing new technologies in a team, working together to develop new devices or strengthening important relationships with different global industries, our work is based on building trusted relationships that help everyone succeed. As a family-run company, we look beyond short-term goals and work to create a future-oriented vision for our employees, our customers and the world in general. We are looking for a layer conductor in Coriolis measuring tube manufacturing (f/m/d) to complement our team and help shape the production of a central core of our Coriolis flowmeters. In this role, you ensure that quality, safety and teamwork go hand in hand in shift operations and that our products are used reliably worldwide. What is at stake here? Are you excited about leading and developing people in the production environment? Do you want to take responsibility for smooth and high-quality production? Does it appeal to you to be close to the action and to make the success of your shift visible on a daily basis? In this role, you combine leadership, organization and technical understanding and thus make an important contribution to products that are used worldwide in the process industry. What tasks will you take on? They shall:
• take over the management of up to 10 employees in 2-shift operations, including employee meetings and the continuous development of the team.
• Ensure day-to-day operations, including employee deployment planning, focus on error-free assembly and active handling of bottlenecks.
• Responsible for meeting the targets in terms of quality, dates and quantities.
• Responsibility for compliance with quality and safety regulations and actively implement Total Productive Maintenance (TPM).
• Perform active shop floor management to control the shift and transparently control targets. What do we expect from you? They:
• have completed basic technical training.
• bring at least 3 years of management and professional experience.
• have experience in the application of lean methods.
• have good user knowledge in MS-Office and SAP.
• communicate very well in German, both verbally and in writing.
• are characterized by communication and teamwork, a sense of responsibility and independence. What can you expect from us?
• We are a family-run, committed company with a sustainable vision.
• we promote lifelong learning with versatile training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e-learning.
• We support a healthy work-life balance with flexible working hours.
• We provide support for sustainable mobility solutions such as public transport.
• We promote family-friendly policies, including childcare places and childcare services during the holidays. How do you apply? To apply, we ask you to upload your documents to our career page. Applications sent to us by e-mail can unfortunately not be considered for data protection reasons. <p

A Endress+ Hauser, i progressi sono fatti attraverso la collaborazione. Come fornitore leader mondiale di strumenti di misura, i nostri circa 17.000 dipendenti stanno plasmando il futuro nel campo dell’automazione dei processi. Che si tratti di innovare e implementare nuove tecnologie in un team, lavorare insieme per sviluppare nuovi dispositivi, o rafforzare relazioni importanti con diverse industrie globali, il nostro lavoro si basa sulla costruzione di relazioni di fiducia che aiutano tutti ad avere successo. Come azienda a conduzione familiare, guardiamo oltre gli obiettivi a breve termine e lavoriamo per creare una visione orientata al futuro per i nostri dipendenti, i nostri clienti e il mondo in generale. Stiamo cercando uno Studente di Lavoro: Junior Process Specialist per integrare il nostro team globale e contribuire attivamente all'analisi basata sui dati e all'ulteriore sviluppo dei processi produttivi e quindi migliorare in modo sostenibile la qualità e l'efficienza. Qual è il punto? Vuoi sviluppare programmi di prova per un sistema di ispezione della vernice ottica e contribuire così visibilmente alla qualità del prodotto? Fa appello a voi per comprendere i requisiti insieme al dipartimento di sviluppo e implementarli in modo pratico? Vuoi sostenere attivamente il team di qualità nell'introduzione e nell'attuazione di un nuovo processo di ispezione? In questo ruolo, combinate tecnologia, analisi e collaborazione e formate attivamente un processo centrale lungo la produzione. Quali compiti assumerai? Lo farai:
• Creare programmi di prova e svilupparli ulteriormente in modo mirato.
• Sostenere l'ingegnere del processo in compiti e progetti quotidiani.
• accompagnare il team di qualità in analisi e ottimizzazioni.
• Valutare i set di dati e analizzarli in modo strutturato.
• derivano misure concrete di miglioramento per il processo di verniciatura dai dati. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te? Tu...
• studi ingegneria elettrica, automazione, meccatronica o un corso di laurea simile con una specializzazione in automazione, ingegneria o sistemi ottici.
• sono all'inizio dei tuoi studi o in un semestre in corso (anche possibile come PiBS).
• portare la conoscenza di base di EDP e CAD.
• avere una buona conoscenza di tedesco, francese e/o inglese in parole e scrittura.
• lavorare con attenzione e indipendentemente, sono flessibili, responsabili, disposti ad imparare, avere una rapida ammissione, capacità di comunicazione e sono aperti a nuove cose. Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi?
• Siamo una società di famiglia con grande impegno e una visione sostenibile.
• Promuoviamo l'apprendimento lungo tutto l'arco della vita attraverso diverse opportunità di formazione e di formazione, trasferimento di conoscenze interne e apprendimento.
• Sosteniamo il vostro equilibrio di vita lavorativa con orari di lavoro flessibili.
• Offriamo supporto a soluzioni di mobilità sostenibile come i trasporti pubblici. Come si applica? Per richiedere, si prega di caricare i documenti nella nostra pagina di carriera. Le domande inviateci via e-mail non possono purtroppo essere considerate per motivi di protezione dei dati. Agenzie, fornitori di servizi del personale o società simili sono tenuti a astenersi dalla trasmissione non richiesta di profili e richieste di possibile cooperazione. Attualmente non lavoriamo con fornitori di servizi esterni per questa posizione. Tutte le applicazioni non richieste dai fornitori di servizi non vengono considerate e eliminate senza ulteriori esami. Grazie per la vostra comprensione. Applichi subito.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Endress+Hauser, progress is made through collaboration. As the world’s leading provider of measuring instruments, our approximately 17,000 employees are shaping the future in the field of process automation. Whether it’s innovating and implementing new technologies in a team, working together to develop new devices, or strengthening important relationships with different global industries, our work is based on building trusted relationships that help everyone succeed. As a family-run company, we look beyond short-term goals and work to create a future-oriented vision for our employees, our customers and the world in general. We are looking for a Working Student: Junior Process Specialist to complement our global team and actively contribute to the data-based analysis and further development of production processes and thus to sustainably improve quality and efficiency. What is the point about? Do you want to develop test programs for an optical paint inspection system and thus contribute visibly to product quality? Does it appeal to you to understand requirements together with the development department and implement them in a practical manner? Do you want to actively support the quality team in introducing and implementing a new inspection process? In this role, you combine technology, analysis and collaboration and actively shape a central process along production. What tasks will you take on? You will:
• Create test programs and further develop them in a targeted manner.
• Support the process engineer in daily tasks and projects.
• accompany the quality team in analyses and optimisations.
• Evaluate data sets and analyze them in a structured manner.
• derive concrete improvement measures for the painting process from the data. What do we expect from you? You:
• studies electrical engineering, automation, mechatronics or a similar degree program with a specialization in automation, engineering or optical systems.
• are at the beginning of your studies or in an ongoing semester (also possible as PiBS).
• bring basic knowledge of EDP and CAD.
• have good knowledge of German, French and/or English in words and writing.
• work carefully and independently, are flexible, responsible, willing to learn, have a quick apprehension, communication skills and are open to new things. What can you expect from us?
• We are a family company with great commitment and a sustainable vision.
• We promote lifelong learning through diverse training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e‐learning.
• We support your work-life balance with flexible working hours.
• We offer support in sustainable mobility solutions such as public transport. How do you apply? To apply, please upload your documents to our career page. Applications sent to us by e-mail can unfortunately not be considered for data protection reasons. Agencies, personnel service providers or similar companies are asked to refrain from the unsolicited transmission of profiles and requests for possible cooperation. We do not currently work with external service providers for this position. All unsolicited applications from service providers are not considered and deleted without further examination. Thank you for your understanding. Apply now.

Are you someone who enjoys taking bold technological steps? Do you like turning ideas into clear software concepts for the future? And do you find joy in guiding others on their journey and setting standards together?

If this sounds like you, you can expect a role where you help shape our future device generations and have a real impact on technologies that people around the world encounter every day.

You will:

• design new software concepts, system architectures, and processes within the software environment as part of a team, laying the foundation for upcoming device generations.

• shape strategic development within software, establish processes and new methods, and continuously improve them.

• support the professional development of employees through active coaching and mentoring.

• play a key role in building and maintaining networks inside and outside the company and represent our interests in standardization organizations.

You:

• have at least 15 years of experience in development, architecture, and real-time design of embedded systems.

• possess excellent knowledge and experience in Embedded C/C++, safety and robustness methods, software quality metrics, and test-driven development.

• have experience in corporate and committee work as well as excellent English skills and at least good German skills.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens through collaboration. As a global leader in measurement instruments, our more than 17,000 employees shape the future of process automation. Whether innovating and implementing new technologies as a team, collaborating on the development of new devices, or strengthening key relationships with various global industries, our work is built on creating trusted connections that lead to success for everyone. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term goals and work toward a forward-thinking vision for our employees, our customers, and the world at large.

We are looking for a Technical Lead Embedded C++ Software Developer to join our team and use your experience to sustainably shape our software landscape—both technically and personally.

What is this role about?

Are you someone who enjoys taking bold technological steps? Do you like turning ideas into clear software concepts for the future? And do you find joy in guiding others on their journey and setting standards together?

If this sounds like you, you can expect a role where you help shape our future device generations and have a real impact on technologies that people around the world encounter every day.

Your responsibilities

You will:

• take on functional and technical software leadership within the context of our current and future software platforms.

• design new software concepts, system architectures, and processes within the software environment as part of a team, laying the foundation for upcoming device generations.

• shape strategic development within software, establish processes and new methods, and continuously improve them.

• support the professional development of employees through active coaching and mentoring.

• play a key role in building and maintaining networks inside and outside the company and represent our interests in standardization organizations.

What we expect from you

You:

• hold a university degree (Master, Doctor of Technical Sciences ETH or equivalent) in Technical Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Automation Technology.

• have at least 15 years of experience in development, architecture, and real-time design of embedded systems.

• possess excellent knowledge and experience in Embedded C/C++, safety and robustness methods, software quality metrics, and test-driven development.

• bring solid knowledge from an industrial environment and are familiar with requirements in regulated application areas such as functional safety or metrology.

• have experience in corporate and committee work as well as excellent English skills and at least good German skills.

What you can expect from us

• We are a family-owned company with strong commitment and a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning through diverse training and development opportunities, internal knowledge transfer, and e-learning.

• We invest in your health with a comprehensive health management program.

• We support you with a company pension plan and initiatives to balance family and work.

• You benefit from a work environment where technological curiosity, appreciation, and creative freedom come together.

How to apply

Please upload your application documents on our career page. Unfortunately, applications sent by email cannot be considered for data protection reasons.

Agencies, personnel service providers, or similar companies are kindly asked not to send unsolicited profiles or inquiries regarding potential collaboration. We are currently not working with external service providers for this position. All unsolicited applications from service providers will not be considered and will be deleted without further review. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.description:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 18,000 employees, we shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with our global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for an Assistant to join us and provide high-level administrative and strategic support to the advisory functions of the CEO at Endress+Hauser Group Services AG. In this role, you will be part of our Group’s global headquarters in Reinach, Switzerland, supporting the Teams Corporate Communication, Internal Audit and Enterprise Development.

What is the role about?

Are you organized, proactive, and comfortable managing a wide range of executive-level responsibilities? Do you thrive on creating structure in an international environment? Are you skilled at anticipating needs and finding solutions before others notice the challenge?

If so, this role is your opportunity to play a vital part in supporting our global leadership. You’ll work directly with the CEO and his teams, coordinating across international teams — ensuring the smooth execution of operational and administrative activities within a dynamic and collaborative corporate environment.

Which tasks will you perform?

You will:

• Assist the three advisory teams of the CEO in all aspects of their administrative, commercial, and relational tasks, both internally and externally.

• Proactively manage the agendas in the short- and medium-term, organizing and coordinating meetings, trips, and events in alignment with other Executive Board members.

• Manage correspondence by prioritizing and responding to emails, ensuring timely communication and efficient information flow.

• Coordinate all travel arrangements, including bookings, documentation, and schedules, ensuring all details are prepared well in advance.

• Support in reporting activities by collecting data from various sources, creating source documents, and preparing monthly reports based on business process system analysis.

• Collaborate closely with other assistants and corporate teams to ensure smooth communication and event organization.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• Hold a degree or equivalent education as an Executive Assistant.

• Are fluent in both German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Bring proven experience supporting executives in an international environment, ideally with a track record of supporting multiple teams simultaneously.

• Demonstrate excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with a high level of professionalism and discretion in handling confidential information.

• Are proficient with Microsoft 365 and modern collaboration tools. Familiarity with business systems such as SAP Business Warehouse and AI tools is an advantage.

• Have a strong digital mindset, curiosity for new tools and the ability to quickly learn and apply new software are essential.

• Show strong self-management, initiative, and the ability to work independently while being a collaborative team player.

• Are curious, adaptable, and motivated to continuously improve processes and expand your knowledge.

What can you expect from us?

• We are a family-owned, highly committed company with a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning with versatile training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer, and e-learning.

• We prioritize employee well-being by offering a comprehensive company pension scheme and access to health offers that support our employees’ overall wellness.

How do you apply?

To apply, we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by email can unfortunately not be considered due to data privacy considerations.

Stiamo cercando un Assistente per unirsi a noi e fornire un supporto amministrativo e strategico di alto livello alle funzioni consultive del CEO di Endress+ Hauser Group Services AG. In questo ruolo, sarete parte della sede globale del nostro Gruppo a Reinach, in Svizzera, a sostegno delle Team Corporate Communication, Internal Audit e Enterprise Development. Qual è il ruolo? Sei organizzato, proattivo e confortevole gestire una vasta gamma di responsabilità a livello esecutivo? Si prospera sulla creazione di una struttura in un ambiente internazionale? Siete abili nell'anticipazione delle esigenze e nella ricerca di soluzioni prima che altri notino la sfida? Se è così, questo ruolo è la vostra opportunità di svolgere un ruolo vitale nel sostenere la nostra leadership globale. Potrai lavorare direttamente con il CEO e i suoi team, coordinando le squadre internazionali, assicurando l'esecuzione regolare delle attività operative e amministrative all'interno di un ambiente aziendale dinamico e collaborativo. Quali compiti eseguirai? Lo farai:
• Assistere i tre team di consulenza del CEO in tutti gli aspetti dei loro compiti amministrativi, commerciali e relazionali, sia internamente che esternamente.
• Gestire attivamente gli ordini del giorno a breve e medio termine, organizzare e coordinare riunioni, viaggi e eventi in allineamento con altri membri del Consiglio Esecutivo.
• Gestisci la corrispondenza privilegiando e rispondendo alle e-mail, garantendo una comunicazione tempestiva e un flusso di informazioni efficiente.
• Coordinate tutte le modalità di viaggio, incluse le prenotazioni, la documentazione e gli orari, assicurando che tutti i dettagli siano preparati in anticipo.
• Sostegno alle attività di reporting raccogliendo dati provenienti da varie fonti, creando documenti sorgente e preparando relazioni mensili basate sull'analisi del sistema di processo aziendale.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con altri assistenti e team aziendali per garantire una comunicazione fluida e organizzazione eventi. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te? Tu...
• Tenere una laurea o un'istruzione equivalente come assistente esecutivo.
• Sono fluenti sia in tedesco che in inglese, con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali.
• Portate l'esperienza comprovata che supporta i dirigenti in un ambiente internazionale, idealmente con un track record di supporto di più squadre contemporaneamente.
• Dimostrare eccellenti capacità organizzative e multitasking, con un alto livello di professionalità e discrezione nella gestione di informazioni riservate.
• Sono abili con Microsoft 365 e moderni strumenti di collaborazione. La familiarità con i sistemi aziendali come SAP Business Warehouse e gli strumenti AI è un vantaggio.
• Avere una forte mentalità digitale, la curiosità per nuovi strumenti e la capacità di imparare e applicare rapidamente nuovi software sono essenziali.
• Mostra forte autogestione, iniziativa, e la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente pur essendo un giocatore di squadra collaborativo.
• Sono curiosi, adattabili e motivati a migliorare continuamente i processi ed espandere la vostra conoscenza. Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi?
• Siamo una società a conduzione familiare, altamente impegnata con una visione sostenibile.
• Promuoviamo l'apprendimento per tutta la vita con una formazione versatile e ulteriori opportunità di istruzione, trasferimento di conoscenze interne e e-learning.
• Prestiamo priorità al benessere dei dipendenti offrendo un sistema pensionistico aziendale completo e l’accesso alle offerte sanitarie che supportano il benessere complessivo dei nostri dipendenti. Come si applica? Per applicare, ti chiediamo gentilmente di caricare i tuoi documenti nella nostra pagina di carriera. jobs.description: At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 17,000 employees, we shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large. We are looking for a Technology Manager - Industrial Networks & IIoT to join Endress+Hauser Digital Solutions and drive our global innovation process, especially in the realm of digital transformation. Endress+Hauser Digital Solutions is our Product Center for the Industrial Internet of Things—where 200 innovators collaborate in 12 agile squads, backed by over 200 IIoT patents and an ISO 27001-certified commitment to security—to deliver cutting-edge hardware, software, and cloud services that unlock the full potential of process-industry data. What is the role about? Are you ready to lead the charge in transforming industrial landscapes through digital innovation? Do you have a passion for strategizing and implementing cutting-edge solutions that shape the future of process industries worldwide? As Technology Manager - Industrial Networks & IIoT, you'll be at the forefront of evaluating technology trends, crafting strategies, and providing strategic guidance for digitalization of process plants based on Ethernet based fieldbus technologies and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) initiatives. Join us in revolutionizing industrial processes and enhancing customer experiences through digital transformation. Which tasks will you perform? You will • Evaluate technological trends and their industrial application as a basis for strategic decisions. • Develop actionable strategies and specifications for implementation based on your assessments. • Provide technology consulting for digitization and IIoT with a focus on customer requirements in process industries. • Support development and sales activities and offer training as an expert on utilized systems and technologies. • Moderate working groups to harmonize internal company standards, guidelines and specifications. • Represent Endress+Hauser in international standard development organizations and committees. What do we expect from you? You • Hold a degree in engineering, preferably complemented with practical experience in product and/or technology management for industrial process automation. • Bring at least 7 years of professional experience. • Are familiar with fieldbus and field device integration technologies as typically applied in process industries today. • Have an insight into the workflows for planning, commissioning and maintaining process plants and process control systems. • Are eager to learn and willing to delve into details to further develop expertise in your field. • Have a high level of communication and social skills and the ability to moderate interdisciplinary working groups. • Communicate fluently in German and English. • Are willing to travel internationally, approximately 20% of the time. What can you expect from us? • A dynamic and innovative work environment at the forefront of digital transformation. • Opportunities and training for professional growth and career development. • A flexible and family-friendly work culture that supports work-life balance. • Competitive salary and benefits package, including health and wellness programs. • The security and prospects of an international, family-owned company that supports sustainability and diversity and has a long-term vision. How do you apply? To apply we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by E-Mail can unfortunately not be considered due to Data Privacy Considerations. Agencies, HR service providers, or similar entities are kindly requested to refrain from unsolicited submission of profiles and inquiries regarding potential collaboration. Currently, we do not engage with external service providers for this role. Any unsolicited applications will be disregarded and deleted without further consideration. We appreciate your understanding. #DL1 Apply now » • Start applying with LinkedIn

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Endress+ Hauser, il progresso avviene lavorando insieme. Come leader globale nella strumentazione di misura, con oltre 17.000 dipendenti, formiamo il futuro nel campo dell'automazione dei processi. Che si sviluppi e realizzi una nuova tecnologia come team, collaborando per costruire la strumentazione, o rafforzare le relazioni vitali con innumerevoli industrie globali, lavoriamo per creare relazioni di fiducia che aiutano tutti a prosperare. In qualità di azienda di proprietà familiare, guardiamo al di là delle mosse a breve termine e lavoriamo per creare una visione che è all'avanguardia per la nostra gente, i nostri clienti, e il mondo in generale. Cerchiamo un Technology Manager - Reti Industriali & IIoT per aderire Endress+ Hauser Digital Solutions e guida il nostro processo di innovazione globale, soprattutto nel campo della trasformazione digitale. Endress+ Hauser Digital Solutions è il nostro Product Center per l'Industrial Internet of Things, dove 200 innovatori collaborano in 12 squadre agili, sostenute da oltre 200 brevetti IIoT e un impegno certificato ISO 27001 per la sicurezza, per fornire hardware, software e servizi cloud all'avanguardia che sbloccano il pieno potenziale dei dati di processo-industria. Qual è il ruolo? Sei pronto a guidare la carica di trasformare i paesaggi industriali attraverso l'innovazione digitale? Hai una passione per lo strategamento e l'implementazione di soluzioni all'avanguardia che modellano il futuro delle industrie di processo in tutto il mondo? In qualità di Technology Manager - Industrial Networks & IIoT, sarai in prima linea nella valutazione delle tendenze tecnologiche, nella creazione di strategie e nella fornitura di una guida strategica per la digitalizzazione degli impianti di processo basati sulle tecnologie di fieldbus Ethernet e sulle iniziative di Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT). Unisciti a noi nella rivoluzione dei processi industriali e nel miglioramento delle esperienze dei clienti attraverso la trasformazione digitale. Quali compiti eseguirai? Lo farai.
• Valutare le tendenze tecnologiche e la loro applicazione industriale come base per decisioni strategiche.
• Sviluppare strategie e specifiche attuabili in base alle tue valutazioni.
• Fornire consulenza tecnologica per la digitalizzazione e IIoT con un focus sui requisiti del cliente nelle industrie di processo.
• Sostenere lo sviluppo e le attività di vendita e offrire formazione come esperto di sistemi e tecnologie utilizzati.
• Gruppi di lavoro moderati per armonizzare gli standard aziendali interni, le linee guida e le specifiche.
• Rappresentare Endress+ Hauser in organizzazioni internazionali di sviluppo standard e comitati. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te? #
• Tenere una laurea in ingegneria, preferibilmente completato con esperienza pratica nella gestione del prodotto e/o della tecnologia per l'automazione dei processi industriali.
• Portare almeno 7 anni di esperienza professionale.
• Sono familiarità con le tecnologie di integrazione di fieldbus e dispositivi di campo, come tipicamente applicato nelle industrie di processo oggi.
• Avere una visione dei flussi di lavoro per la pianificazione, la messa in servizio e il mantenimento di impianti di processo e sistemi di controllo di processo.
• Sono desiderosi di imparare e disposti a approfondire i dettagli per sviluppare ulteriormente le competenze nel vostro campo.
• Avere un alto livello di comunicazione e competenze sociali e la capacità di moderato gruppi di lavoro interdisciplinari.
• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco e inglese.
• Sono disposti a viaggiare a livello internazionale, circa il 20% del tempo. Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi?
• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e innovativo all'avanguardia della trasformazione digitale.
• Opportunità e formazione per la crescita professionale e lo sviluppo della carriera.
• Una cultura del lavoro flessibile e familiare che supporta l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa.
• Pacchetto di stipendio e benefici competitivi, compresi i programmi di salute e benessere.
• La sicurezza e le prospettive di una società internazionale di proprietà familiare che supporta la sostenibilità e la diversità e ha una visione a lungo termine. Come si applica? Per applicare ti chiediamo gentilmente di caricare i tuoi documenti nella nostra pagina di carriera. Le domande inviateci da E-Mail non possono purtroppo essere considerate a causa delle Considerazioni sulla privacy dei dati. Agenzie, fornitori di servizi HR o entità simili sono cortesemente invitati a astenersi dalla presentazione non richiesta di profili e richieste per quanto riguarda la potenziale collaborazione. Attualmente, non ci impegniamo con fornitori di servizi esterni per questo ruolo. Eventuali applicazioni non richieste saranno ignorate e eliminate senza ulteriori considerazioni. Apprezziamo la vostra comprensione. #DL1 Richiedi ora »

jobs.description:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 18,000 employees shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for an Expert Global Production Master Data (f/m/d) to join our team and help lay the foundation for a connected, efficient, and future-ready global production environment where data makes the difference.

What is this position about?

Do you enjoy connecting complex production processes on a global scale? Are you excited about using data to make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and innovation? Do you find international coordination and cross-site collaboration motivating?

If so, you can expect an exciting role in which you will actively shape and further develop the digital backbone of our global production.

What tasks will you perform?

You will:

• work in a dynamic, globally operating team and collaborate across sites with production, engineering, and digitalization functions.

• coordinate complex alignments within an international production network.

• define, maintain, and ensure the quality of production master data, including variant configuration, and ensure consistent data structures throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• contribute to and optimize standards, processes, and continuous improvements in master data maintenance, driving global harmonization, standardization, and the further development of underlying process logic.

• take responsibility as a (sub-)project manager in product development projects for the global industrialization of new products and steer cross-site introduction and rollout activities within the international manufacturing network.

• ensure coordination and implementation of changes across the entire product lifecycle as a product-responsible manufacturing planner.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• hold a degree in a technical field (e.g., production engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or similar) and have at least 8 years of professional experience in an industrial environment, with proven experience in production-related engineering, master data and industrialization roles, as well as international experience.

• bring strong expert knowledge in maintaining SAP production master data, particularly in routings, bills of materials, and variant configuration, along with a deep understanding of SAP ERP as a central system for managing and integrating core processes such as materials management, production planning, logistics, and master data.

• have proven experience in implementing, rolling out, or further developing SAP ME in a variant-rich manufacturing environment and are experienced in the operational implementation of complex system and process dependencies between the shop floor, SAP ME and SAP ERP.

• have at least 8 years of experience in project management and in the industrialization of new products, the introduction of new products, processes, or technologies, as well as cross-site rollouts in an international environment.

• possess a strong global mindset, intercultural competence, and the ability to effectively manage and coordinate complex topics in an international and decentralized production network. You can assess different requirements, priorities, processes, maturity levels, and local conditions of international production sites and translate them into sustainable, globally consistent, and implementable solutions.

• convince with a high level of communication, alignment, and integration skills across countries, functions, and locations, and have the ability to bring together diverse stakeholders with sometimes differing interests while sustainably harmonizing and optimizing global master data processes.

• are fluent in English, both written and spoken, and work in a structured, responsible and team-oriented manner.

What can you expect from us?

• We are a family-owned company with a strong commitment and a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning through diverse training and development opportunities, internal knowledge transfer, and e-learning.

• We support work-life balance with flexible working hours.

• We offer support for sustainable mobility solutions such as public transportation.

• We support family-friendly policies, including childcare places and childcare services during school holidays.

• We offer you a meaningful role with global impact in a stable and innovative working environment.

How do you apply?

To apply we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by E-Mail can unfortunately not be considered due to Data Privacy Considerations.

Agencies, HR service providers, or similar entities are kindly requested to refrain from unsolicited submission of profiles and inquiries regarding potential collaboration. Currently, we do not engage with external service providers for this role. Any unsolicited applications will be disregarded and deleted without further consideration. We appreciate your understanding.

Apply now »

• portare una forte conoscenza esperta nel mantenere i dati master di produzione SAP, in particolare in routing, bollette di materiali e configurazione delle varianti, insieme a una profonda comprensione di SAP ERP come sistema centrale per la gestione e l'integrazione di processi core come la gestione dei materiali, la pianificazione della produzione, la logistica e i dati master.
• hanno dimostrato esperienza nell'implementazione, nel roll out o nello sviluppo di SAP ME in un ambiente di produzione ricco di varianti e sono sperimentati nell'implementazione operativa di complesse dipendenze di sistema e processo tra il piano del negozio, SAP ME e SAP ERP.
• hanno almeno 8 anni di esperienza nella gestione del progetto e nell'industrializzazione di nuovi prodotti, l'introduzione di nuovi prodotti, processi o tecnologie, così come rollout cross-site in un ambiente internazionale.
• possedere una forte mentalità globale, competenze interculturali, e la capacità di gestire e coordinare efficacemente argomenti complessi in una rete di produzione internazionale e decentralizzata. • convincere con un alto livello di comunicazione, allineamento e capacità di integrazione in paesi, funzioni e luoghi, e avere la capacità di riunire diversi stakeholder con interessi a volte diversi, armonizzando e ottimizzando in modo sostenibile i processi di dati master globali.
• sono fluenti in inglese, sia scritto che parlato, e lavorano in modo strutturato, responsabile e orientato al team. Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi?

Wir suchen einen Expert Global Production Master Data (w/m/d), der unserem Team beitritt und die Grundlage für eine vernetzte, effiziente und zukunftsfähige globale Produktionsumgebung schafft, in der Daten den Unterschied ausmachen. Sind Sie begeistert davon, Daten zu nutzen, um einen echten Einfluss auf Qualität, Effizienz und Innovation zu haben? Finden Sie internationale Koordination und standortübergreifende Zusammenarbeit motivierend? Dann erwarten Sie eine spannende Rolle, in der Sie das digitale Rückgrat unserer globalen Produktion aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln werden. Welche Aufgaben werden Sie ausführen? Sie werden
• Arbeiten Sie in einem dynamischen, global agierenden Team und arbeiten Sie standortübergreifend mit Produktions-, Engineering- und Digitalisierungsfunktionen zusammen.
• Koordination komplexer Ausrichtungen innerhalb eines internationalen Produktionsnetzwerks.
• Festlegung, Pflege und Sicherstellung der Qualität der Produktionsstammdaten, einschließlich der Variantenkonfiguration, sowie Gewährleistung einheitlicher Datenstrukturen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.
• Beitrag zu und Optimierung von Standards, Prozessen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungen in der Stammdatenpflege, Förderung der globalen Harmonisierung, Standardisierung und Weiterentwicklung der zugrunde liegenden Prozesslogik.

• Gewährleistung der Koordination und Umsetzung von Änderungen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus als produktverantwortlicher Fertigungsplaner. Was erwarten wir von Ihnen? Sie:
• einen Abschluss in einem technischen Bereich (z. B. Produktionstechnik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ähnliches) und mindestens 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem industriellen Umfeld mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in Produktionstechnik, Stammdaten und Industrialisierungsrollen sowie internationaler Erfahrung haben.
• Bringen Sie fundiertes Expertenwissen in die Pflege von SAP-Produktionsstammdaten, insbesondere in Routings, Materialrechnungen und Variantenkonfiguration, sowie ein tiefes Verständnis von SAP ERP als zentrales System zur Verwaltung und Integration von Kernprozessen wie Materialmanagement, Produktionsplanung, Logistik und Stammdaten mit.
• über ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der Implementierung, Einführung oder Weiterentwicklung von SAP ME in einer variantenreichen Fertigungsumgebung verfügen und über Erfahrung in der operativen Umsetzung komplexer System- und Prozessabhängigkeiten zwischen Shopfloor, SAP ME und SAP ERP verfügen.
• mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und in der Industrialisierung neuer Produkte, der Einführung neuer Produkte, Prozesse oder Technologien sowie standortübergreifender Rollouts im internationalen Umfeld.
• besitzen eine starke globale Denkweise, interkulturelle Kompetenz und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen in einem internationalen und dezentralen Produktionsnetzwerk effektiv zu verwalten und zu koordinieren. Chez Endress+ Hauser, le progrès se produit en travaillant ensemble. Leader mondial de l'instrumentation de mesure, plus de 18 000 employés façonnent l'avenir dans le domaine de l'automatisation des processus. Qu'il s'agisse de développer et de réaliser de nouvelles technologies en équipe, de collaborer à la construction d'instruments ou de renforcer les relations vitales avec d'innombrables industries mondiales, nous travaillons à créer des relations de confiance qui aident chacun à prospérer. En tant qu'entreprise familiale, nous regardons au-delà des mouvements à court terme et travaillons pour créer une vision qui est prospective pour nos gens, nos clients et le monde en général. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Master Data Expert Global Production (f/m/d) pour rejoindre notre équipe et contribuer à jeter les bases d'un environnement de production mondial connecté, efficace et prêt à l'avenir où les données font la différence. Quelle est cette position ? Vous aimez connecter des processus de production complexes à l'échelle mondiale ? Êtes-vous excité par l'utilisation des données pour avoir un impact réel sur la qualité, l'efficacité et l'innovation? Trouvez-vous la coordination internationale et la collaboration intersite motivante? Si oui, vous pouvez vous attendre à un rôle passionnant dans lequel vous façonnerez et développerez activement l'épine dorsale numérique de notre production mondiale. Quelles tâches allez-vous accomplir? Vous:
• travailler dans une équipe dynamique et mondiale et collaborer à travers les sites avec des fonctions de production, d'ingénierie et de numérisation.
• coordonner des alignements complexes au sein d'un réseau international de production.
• définir, maintenir et assurer la qualité des données maîtresses de production, y compris la configuration des variantes, et assurer la cohérence des structures de données tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• contribuer et optimiser les normes, les processus et les améliorations continues de la maintenance des données maîtresses, favoriser l'harmonisation mondiale, la normalisation et le développement de la logique de processus sous-jacente.
• prendre la responsabilité en tant que (sous-)gestionnaire de projets de développement de produits pour l'industrialisation mondiale de nouveaux produits et orienter les activités d'introduction et de déploiement trans-site au sein du réseau international de fabrication.
• assurer la coordination et la mise en oeuvre des changements tout au long du cycle de vie du produit en tant que planificateur de fabrication responsable du produit. Qu'attendons-nous de vous ? Vous :
• Être titulaire d'un diplôme dans un domaine technique (p. ex., génie de la production, génie mécanique, génie industriel, etc.) et avoir au moins 8 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans un environnement industriel, avec une expérience éprouvée dans le domaine de l'ingénierie de la production, des données de maîtrise et de l'industrialisation, ainsi qu'une expérience internationale.
• apporter une solide connaissance experte dans le maintien des données de base de production SAP, en particulier dans les routages, les factures de matériaux et la configuration des variantes, ainsi qu'une compréhension approfondie de SAP ERP en tant que système central de gestion et d'intégration des processus de base tels que la gestion des matériaux, la planification de la production, la logistique et les données de base.
• ont prouvé l'expérience dans la mise en œuvre, le déploiement ou le développement de SAP ME dans un environnement de fabrication riche en variantes et sont expérimentés dans la mise en œuvre opérationnelle de systèmes complexes et dépendances de processus entre l'atelier, SAP ME et SAP ERP.
• avoir au moins 8 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de projets et dans l'industrialisation de nouveaux produits, l'introduction de nouveaux produits, procédés ou technologies, ainsi que des déploiements inter-site dans un environnement international.
• posséder une solide mentalité mondiale, une compétence interculturelle et la capacité de gérer et de coordonner efficacement des sujets complexes dans un réseau de production international et décentralisé. Vous pouvez évaluer les différentes exigences, priorités, processus, niveaux de maturité et conditions locales des sites de production internationaux et les traduire en solutions durables, cohérentes à l'échelle mondiale et réalisables.
• convaincre avec un haut niveau de communication, d'alignement et d'intégration des compétences dans les pays, les fonctions et les lieux, et avoir la capacité de réunir diverses parties prenantes avec des intérêts parfois différents tout en harmonisant et optimisant durablement les processus mondiaux de gestion des données.

A Endress+ Hauser, i progressi sono fatti attraverso la collaborazione. Che si tratti di innovare e implementare nuove tecnologie in un team, lavorare insieme per sviluppare nuovi dispositivi o rafforzare relazioni importanti con diverse industrie globali, il nostro lavoro si basa sulla costruzione di relazioni di fiducia che aiutano tutti ad avere successo. Come azienda a conduzione familiare, guardiamo oltre gli obiettivi a breve termine e lavoriamo per creare una visione orientata al futuro per i nostri dipendenti, i nostri clienti e il mondo in generale. Stiamo cercando un project manager nella gestione delle strutture (m/f/d) per integrare il nostro team di gestione delle strutture nel sito Reinach e sviluppare congiuntamente un'infrastruttura sostenibile, moderna e orientata al futuro. Ti piace riunire diversi stakeholder e implementare soluzioni insieme? In questo ruolo, formerai attivamente la nostra tecnologia di costruzione e guiderai progetti in avanti che hanno un impatto diretto su un ambiente di lavoro sostenibile ed efficiente. Quali compiti assumerai? Essi:
• occupare la gestione complessiva dei progetti di piccole e medie dimensioni (0,1 - 10 milioni) nel settore della gestione degli impianti presso il sito Reinach, garantendo qualità, scadenze e costi.
• focalizzarsi su progetti impegnativi nella costruzione della tecnologia e promuovere attivamente e sviluppare ulteriormente l'attuazione delle misure della strategia energetica 2030+.
• i progettisti interni ed esterni e le aziende che eseguono conducono e coordinano, implementano linee guida strategiche in modo operativo e, se necessario, partecipano attivamente alla gestione delle costruzioni.
• agire come interfaccia a diverse aree di business e quindi garantire una cooperazione regolare.
• Contribuisci la tua esperienza in attrezzature per la costruzione tecnica e supporta i colleghi da operazioni e manutenzione in modo mirato. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te? Loro:
• hanno una qualifica professionale nel campo della tecnologia di costruzione (automazione di costruzione o HVAC) con ulteriore formazione come tecnico di costruzione HF/FH o comparabile e conoscere gli standard SIA.
• hanno diversi anni di esperienza in progetti tecnicamente impegnativi nell'ambiente industriale e idealmente una formazione di project management (IPMA Level C).
• preferibilmente portare la conoscenza di strumenti CAD e la piattaforma di gestione degli edifici DesigoCC.
• master tedesco in parola e scrittura, la conoscenza dell'inglese è un vantaggio.
• Pensare concettualmente, agire orientato alla soluzione e comunicare in modo chiaro e convincente.
• A loro piace lavorare in una squadra e vogliono fare la differenza insieme ad altri. Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi?
• Siamo una società di famiglia con grande impegno e una visione sostenibile.
• Promuoviamo l'apprendimento lungo tutto l'arco della vita attraverso diverse opportunità di formazione e di formazione, trasferimento di conoscenze interne e e-learning.
• Sosteniamo il vostro equilibrio di vita lavorativa con orari di lavoro flessibili.
• Offriamo supporto a soluzioni di mobilità sostenibile come i trasporti pubblici.
• Ci concentriamo sulle condizioni quadro a misura di famiglia, compresi i servizi di assistenza all'infanzia. Come si applica? As the world’s leading provider of measuring instruments, our approximately 17,000 employees are shaping the future in the field of process automation. Whether it’s innovating and implementing new technologies in a team, working together to develop new devices or strengthening important relationships with different global industries, our work is based on building trusted relationships that help everyone succeed. As a family-run company, we look beyond short-term goals and work to create a future-oriented vision for our employees, our customers and the world in general. We are looking for a project manager in facility management (m/f/d) to complement our facility management team at the Reinach site and jointly develop a sustainable, modern and future-oriented infrastructure. What is at stake here? Do you want to control demanding technical projects on your own responsibility? Does it appeal to you to actively contribute to the Energy Strategy 2030+ at our campus? Do you enjoy bringing together different stakeholders and implementing solutions together? In this role, you will actively shape our building technology and drive forward projects that have a direct impact on a sustainable and efficient working environment. What tasks will you take on? They shall: • take over the overall project management of small to medium-sized projects (0.1 - 10 million) in the area of facility management at the Reinach site, ensuring quality, deadlines and costs. • focus on challenging projects in building technology and actively promote and further develop the implementation of the measures of the Energy Strategy 2030+. • internal and external planners and executing companies lead and coordinate, implement strategic guidelines operationally and, if necessary, actively participate in the construction management. • act as an interface to different business areas and thus ensure smooth cooperation. • Contribute your expertise in technical building equipment and support colleagues from operations and maintenance in a targeted manner. What do we expect from you? They: • have a professional qualification in the field of building technology (building automation or HVAC) with further training as building technician HF/FH or comparable and know the SIA standards. • have several years of experience in technically challenging projects in the industrial environment and ideally a project management training (IPMA Level C). • preferably bring knowledge of CAD tools and the building management platform DesigoCC. • master German in word and writing, knowledge of English is an advantage. • Think conceptually, act solution-oriented and communicate clearly and convincingly. • They like to work in a team and want to make a difference together with others. What can you expect from us? • We are a family company with great commitment and a sustainable vision. • We promote lifelong learning through diverse training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e-learning. • We support your work-life balance with flexible working hours. • We offer support in sustainable mobility solutions such as public transport. • We focus on family-friendly framework conditions, including childcare services. We do not currently work with external service providers for this position. All unsolicited applications from service providers are not considered and deleted without further examination. Dans ce rôle, vous allez façonner activement notre technologie de construction et faire avancer des projets qui ont un impact direct sur un environnement de travail durable et efficace. Quelles tâches allez-vous entreprendre? Ils: • prendre en charge la gestion globale des projets de petite à moyenne dimension (0,1 à 10 millions) dans le domaine de la gestion des installations sur le site de Reinach, en assurant la qualité, les délais et les coûts. • mettre l'accent sur des projets stimulants dans le domaine de la construction technologique et promouvoir et développer activement la mise en œuvre des mesures de la stratégie énergétique 2030+. • les planificateurs internes et externes et les sociétés d'exécution dirigent et coordonnent, mettent en œuvre des lignes directrices stratégiques de manière opérationnelle et, si nécessaire, participent activement à la gestion de la construction. • agir en tant qu'interface avec différents secteurs d'activité et ainsi assurer une coopération harmonieuse. • Apportez votre expertise en équipement de construction technique et aidez vos collègues des opérations et de l'entretien de manière ciblée. Qu'attendons-nous de vous ? Ils : • ont une qualification professionnelle dans le domaine de la technologie du bâtiment (automatisation du bâtiment ou CVC) avec une formation continue en tant que technicien de bâtiment HF/FH ou comparable et connaissent les normes SIA. • avoir plusieurs années d'expérience dans des projets techniquement difficiles dans l'environnement industriel et idéalement une formation en gestion de projet (IPMA niveau C). • de préférence apporter la connaissance des outils CAO et la plate-forme de gestion du bâtiment DesigoCC. • maîtrise l'allemand en paroles et en écriture, la connaissance de l'anglais est un avantage. • Pensez conceptuellement, agissez en fonction de la solution et communiquez clairement et de manière convaincante. • Ils aiment travailler en équipe et veulent faire une différence avec les autres.
